source: Curated seed list. A daily job appends new items to `ideas` (keep `id` unique) and bumps `updated`.

ideas.name: Istanbul
ideas.note: Blue Mosque, Süleymaniye and the Bosphorus; mild autumn weather.

ideas.name: Granada
ideas.note: Alhambra palace and the Albaicín quarter; spring gardens.

ideas.name: Córdoba
ideas.note: The Mezquita and the May patios festival.

ideas.name: Sarajevo
ideas.note: Baščaršija bazaar and Gazi Husrev-beg Mosque; halal food everywhere.

ideas.name: Mostar
ideas.note: Stari Most bridge over the Neretva.

ideas.name: Zermatt
ideas.note: Car-free ski village under the Matterhorn.

ideas.name: Innsbruck
ideas.note: Alpine city with ski areas a short tram/bus away.

ideas.name: London
ideas.note: Museums, parks and East London Mosque.

ideas.name: Lisbon
ideas.note: Hills, trams and Atlantic light.

ideas.name: Reykjavík
ideas.note: Northern lights; very short winter days (check prayer times!).

ideas.name: Québec City
ideas.note: Winter Carnival (Feb) and old-town walls.

ideas.name: Banff
ideas.note: Rockies skiing; Lake Louise in summer.

ideas.name: Niagara Falls
ideas.note: Easy family day trip from Toronto.

ideas.name: Marrakech
ideas.note: Koutoubia Mosque and souks; avoid peak summer heat.

ideas.name: Kuala Lumpur
ideas.note: Masjid Negara, Petronas Towers, great halal food.

ideas.name: Mont-Tremblant
ideas.note: Fall colours in October, skiing in winter.

ideas.name: Seville
ideas.note: Real Alcázar and the Giralda (a former minaret); warm, uncrowded autumn days.

ideas.name: Abu Dhabi
ideas.note: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Louvre Abu Dhabi; pleasant weather Nov–Mar, halal everywhere.

ideas.name: Bursa
ideas.note: Ulu Camii and Ottoman-era hammams, plus skiing on nearby Uludağ.

ideas.name: Vienna
ideas.note: Christmas markets at Rathausplatz and Schönbrunn from mid-November, plus the Imperial Palace and grand coffee houses.

ideas.name: Doha
ideas.note: Museum of Islamic Art, Souq Waqif and the Corniche; cool, sunny Nov–Mar and fully halal.

ideas.name: Penang
ideas.note: George Town's heritage streets, Kapitan Keling Mosque and famous halal street food; driest Dec–Feb.

ideas.name: Valletta
ideas.note: Baroque harbour capital with warm sea into November; day trip to Mdina.

ideas.name: Muscat
ideas.note: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Mutrah Souq and mountain wadis; pleasant Nov–Mar.

ideas.name: Cappadocia
ideas.note: Göreme fairy chimneys, cave hotels and sunrise balloon flights; crisp autumn days.

ideas.name: Prague
ideas.note: Old Town Square, Charles Bridge and Prague Castle; golden autumn colours, Christmas markets from late November.

ideas.name: AlUla
ideas.note: Hegra's Nabataean tombs, Elephant Rock and desert canyons; cool, clear days Nov–Mar.

ideas.name: Stone Town, Zanzibar
ideas.note: Swahili-Muslim old town, spice farms and Indian Ocean beaches; dry season Dec–Feb.

ideas.name: Strasbourg
ideas.note: One of Europe's oldest Christmas markets (late Nov–Dec), half-timbered Petite France and a Gothic cathedral.

ideas.name: Dubai
ideas.note: Pleasant 25°C winters, desert safaris, Al Fahidi old quarter and easy halal food everywhere.

ideas.name: Fes
ideas.note: Medieval medina, al-Qarawiyyin (world's oldest university) and tanneries; mild, uncrowded in autumn.

ideas.name: Budapest
ideas.note: Thermal baths in crisp weather, Christmas markets from late November, and halal spots around the Jewish Quarter and Rákóczi Street.

ideas.name: Edinburgh
ideas.note: Moody autumn Old Town, Arthur's Seat hikes, and plenty of halal food near Nicolson Street and the Central Mosque.

ideas.name: Alanya
ideas.note: Warm Mediterranean sea into November, a clifftop Seljuk castle, and fully halal Turkish hospitality without the summer crowds.

ideas.name: Bruges
ideas.note: Canal-side medieval lanes in misty autumn colour, with the Christmas market opening in late November; Brussels nearby has plenty of halal food.

ideas.name: Petra
ideas.note: Mild late-autumn days are ideal for hiking to the Treasury and Monastery, with Wadi Rum desert camps close by in a fully Muslim-friendly country.

ideas.name: Langkawi
ideas.note: Duty-free tropical island that hits its dry season from November, with the SkyBridge cable car, mangrove tours and halal food everywhere.

ideas.name: Salzburg
ideas.note: Mozart's baroque old town under Hohensalzburg Fortress, with Advent markets from mid-November and Alpine day trips to Hallstatt.

ideas.name: Luxor
ideas.note: Karnak, Luxor Temple and the Valley of the Kings are best in the mild November to February weather, with sunrise balloon rides and halal food everywhere.

ideas.name: Bukhara
ideas.note: Silk Road city of madrasas, the Kalyan Minaret and the shrine of Imam Bahauddin Naqshband, pleasant through early November.
